    Eliminate Knee Pain The Natural Way

    Too many people suffer from chronic knee pain for years on end and struggle staying active because they fear the consequences of medical procedures.

    The most common knee pain treatments are harmful and often ineffective shots or extremely risky surgeries.

    People are left with having pain every single day at every single step or deciding for procedures that can cost too much and be completely ineffective.

    The FlexiKnee™️ was developed for this exact reason: To provide a healthy, natural way to relieve knee pain instantly while allowing the knee to gradually reverse the damage.

    How (And Why) It Works

    The FlexiKnee™️ uses targeted stimulation to provide vital elements that increase blood flow, eliminate inflammation and help restore the natural cartilage layer in the knee which results in the reversal of damage and elimination of your chronic pain, osteoarthritis and swelling & stiffness.

    The Breakthrough Discovery

    Knee issues keep coming back and current solutions are not fixing the underlying causes.

    After years of research & development, interviews and countless of prototypes & tests, the team at MassageLab carefully engineered the 3 most important elements against knee pain.

    The main innovation of the FlexiKnee™️ comes from combining the most effective solutions to knee pain:

    • Relieve and eliminate inflammation

    • Increase blood flow and speed up regeneration

    • Reduce swelling and increase flexibility

    By combining the 3 most important concepts of knee pain the FlexiKnee™️ results in instant relief of chronic knee pain.

    Science Backed, Potent All Natural Ingredients

    Wormwood

    A bitter herb known for its powerful analgesic (pain-relieving) and anti-inflammatory properties. Studies show it helps alleviate pain while promoting muscle and joint flexibility. With promising results for treating knee osteoarthritis.1

    Capsaicin

    A natural compound found in chili peppers with incredible analgesic (pain-relieving) effects. Multiple studies show it’s effective in reducing osteoarthritis pain in various joints such as the hand, knee, hip or shoulder.2

    In a double-blind randomized study, after four weeks rheumatoid arthritis patients experienced a mean pain reduction of 57% and osteoarthritis patients had a reduction of 33%.3

    Borneol

    A naturally occurring compound found in various plants, known for its mighty analgesic (pain-relieving) abilities. A randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled clinical study demonstrated a single application of borneol (for approximately 30–60 min) produced a substantial reduction in postoperative pain.4

    Radix Aconiti

    A highly potent herb used in Eastern medicine for its analgesic (pain-alleviating) and anti-inflammatory properties. It also improves blood circulation to help your knee recover. Modern pharmacological studies have shown that Radix Aconiti has a good therapeutic effect on rheumatoid arthritis and neuropathic pain.5

    Saffron

    One of the most expensive spices in the world, with proven anti-inflammatory, anticancer, and antioxidant properties. Studies have shown that crocin, the main biologically active component of saffron, has potential therapeutic effects on bone and cartilage diseases that involve inflammation and accumulation of free radicals, including osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and osteoporosis.6

    Cinnamon

    A spice taken from the bark of trees, that contains antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Crucial for reducing inflammation and reducing damage from free radicals inside your knee. (Free radicals push and bump into your knee cells, which damages their structure and disrupts normal functions. Antioxidants act as a barrier to protect your knee.)

    Ginger Extract

    A root used in Eastern Medicine for its antithrombotic (Anti blood clots) and anti-inflammatory properties. A study demonstrated that ginger patches can alleviate pain and disability in individuals with osteoarthritis, with sustained benefits over a 24-week self-treatment period. It also showed improved physical function, pain, and health satisfaction, while having potential to delay or replace more invasive treatments.7

    Camphor

    A waxy substance used in Eastern medicine for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic (pain-alleviating) properties. It desensitizes your pain receptors and blocks specific pain transmission channels, providing relief through soothing warming and cooling sensations.8 It also increases blood flow to supply the resources needed to help your knee repair.

    Menthol

    A natural compound derived from mint plants with analgesic (pain-alleviating) and anti-inflammatory effects. It desensitizes pain receptors, producing a cooling effect that can help soothe the knee joint, reduce swelling, and provide a numbing sensation to temporarily alleviate pain and discomfort.9

    All 9 Science Backed Potent, Natural Ingredients Work in Harmony to:

    1. Dull your pain receptors, making them less sensitive to give you near-instant relief.

    2. Reduce swelling and inflammation which keeps the pain away for a longer time.

    3. Increase blood flow to the damaged areas, bringing the nutrients and oxygen needed to reverse the damage.

    Many customers feel a warming, soothing sensation within minutes of applying the patch, with noticeable pain reduction often reported within the first few days. For chronic issues like osteoarthritis, consistent daily use over 2-4 weeks tends to bring the most significant improvement.

    One patch per knee, per day, is the standard use - each patch is designed to provide up to 12 hours of pain relief. Do not apply more than one patch to the same area within a 24-hour period.

    FlexiKnee was specifically developed for these common knee issues. Its natural ingredients target inflammation, blood flow, and pain receptors around the joint - helping ease the discomfort associated with osteoarthritis, meniscus damage, chronic swelling, and worn cartilage.
